# mws_metastore_iceberg_role_binding (Resource)

Привязка роли для ресурсов Iceberg

## Примеры использования

```terraform
resource "mws_iam_service_account" "example" {
  service_account = var.service_account_name
}

resource "mws_metastore_iceberg" "example" {
  catalog_name = var.catalog_name

  service_account = {
    ref = mws_iam_service_account.example.metadata.id
  }

  properties = {
    location = var.warehouse_location
  }
}

resource "mws_metastore_iceberg_role_binding" "example" {
  role_binding = var.role_binding_name
  role         = "metastore.icebergAdmin"
  subject      = mws_iam_service_account.example.metadata.id

  resource = {
    catalog = mws_metastore_iceberg.example.catalog_name
  }
}

variable "service_account_name" {
  type        = string
  default     = "example-iceberg-reader"
  description = "Service account name"
}

variable "catalog_name" {
  type        = string
  default     = "example-catalog"
  description = "Iceberg catalog name"
}

variable "warehouse_location" {
  type        = string
  default     = "s3://example-bucket/warehouse"
  description = "Object Storage location of the Iceberg warehouse"
}

variable "role_binding_name" {
  type        = string
  default     = "rb__example-iceberg-viewer"
  description = "Iceberg role binding name"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `resource` (Attributes) Спецификация ресурса для привязки роли (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resource))
- `role` (String) Роль для назначения ("metastore.icebergAdmin", "metastore.icebergEditor", "metastore.icebergViewer")
- `role_binding` (String) Имя привязки роли в IAM. Имя задаётся пользователем; рекомендуется использовать префикс "rb__".
- `subject` (String) Идентификатор субъекта (пользователь, сервисный аккаунт и т.д.)

### Optional

- `kind` (String)
- `metadata` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `project` (String) Путь к проекту.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (Attributes) Текущее состояние ресурса, вычисляемое системой (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = mws_mk8s_cluster.example
  identity = {
    project      = "<project>"
    role_binding = "<role_binding>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `role_binding` (String) Имя привязки роли в IAM. Имя задаётся пользователем; рекомендуется использовать префикс `rb__`.

#### Optional

- `project` (String) Путь к проекту.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform

  to = mws_metastore_iceberg_role_binding.example
  id = "metastore/projects/<project>/icebergRoleBindings/<role_binding>"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mws_metastore_iceberg_role_binding.example "metastore/projects/<project>/icebergRoleBindings/<role_binding>"
```
